outcome: abnormalities on brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
cohort: 380 neonates born at >=35 weeks' gestation treated with therapeutic hypothermia for hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE).
finding: Acute kidney injury (AKI) is strongly associated with abnormalities on brain MRI or death in neonates with hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE).
